subject: ... and now for something completely different
author: ZombieTron
body:
well not completely because it is still a tweet, but it's a useful, informative on topic tweet, with no signs of randomness or movie quotations!

CriterionGames "New DLC Bundle Pricing coming soon. More details in Feb!" 

So it looks like the DLC for Burnout Paradise will be getting a price drop!!! (possibly) I found the DLC to be on the expensive side of worth buying, so hopefully this announcement will give those Paradise fans who haven't bought all the DLC yet as it was too expensive, something to look forward to.

As my copy of Burnout Paradise has been boxed away now, and I have no intention of returning to it, this has no affect on me whatsoever.  I will probably do a front page news story about it when we get more details in Feb tho!

See ya on Revenge! 😃

subject: Criterion Games Random Movie Quotes
author: ZombieTron
body:
Oh well, so much for my conspiracy theories, after another movie quote tweet "Welcome back to 'World of The Psychic....'" Criterion Games announce that there is nothing in their tweets "You must not read anything into these Tweets. We not 'teasing' or 'announcing' anything game related. Never on Twitter anyway."

So, I guess the new CG NFS is NOT going to be set in a galaxy far, far away, under the sea on an ice planet with green ghosts and aliens....
